hero.description: Create a wishlist, share the link, and let friends claim items so there’s no duplicate gifts. No app download required.

features.heading: Everything you need
features.subheading: Simple tools to make gift-giving effortless for everyone.
features.shareDesc: Generate a public link and share it via text, email, or social media. No account needed to view.
features.claimDesc: Friends sign in to claim what they’re buying. No more awkward conversations about who got what.
features.autofillDesc: Paste any product URL and we’ll automatically pull the title, description, and image for you.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subheading: Up and running in under two minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Set up your wishlist and add items by pasting URLs or manually. Set a deadline for special occasions.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Copy your unique link and send it to friends or family. They don’t need an account to see your list.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Friends sign in to claim what they’re buying. You’ll receive no duplicates—everyone sees what’s taken.

cta.heading: Ready to make gifting easy?
cta.description: Create your first wishlist in seconds. Free, forever.
